completion_rule: Add another method only if it represents a genuinely different family, is sufficiently specified, has suitable public inputs, can be frozen before independent access, and is comparable without conflating episode and catalogue tasks.
next_scientific_requirement: new independent survey data or a denser exposure-controlled radar-scale catalogue, not post-result tuning
